confidence_notes: Bilbao surveys support the meal, cappuccino and draft beer estimates. comparable_city_reasoning: The lodging estimates place Bilbao between Vitoria-Gasteiz's quieter summer city market and San Sebastián's stronger coastal holiday demand.
